wargear.name: Death-mask
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A gilded helm cast in the austere, grieving face of the Primarch. The model gains Fear (1) and +1 Leadership.

wargear.name: Grail of the Red Tide
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A chalice of sanctified blood carried with the unit and shared before the charge. Every model in the unit gains Feel No Pain (6+).

option.text: The Sergeant may take a weapon of the Host
Up to three models may take a Wing-spar glaive
Up to three Ofanim may take an Encarmine sabre
Up to four Erelim may take an Angelus bolter
The Sergeant may wear a Death-mask
The unit may carry a Grail of the Red Tide

modifiers.text: The Golden Host fights as a dance, and is as fragile: +1 I, -1 T.
Crimson Paladins hit like falling bastions: +1 S, -1 I.
Ofanim, shielded by the Primarch's grace: 5+ Invulnerable Save, -1 M.
Blood Angels would sooner be at the blade: +1 WS, -1 BS.
The Red Thirst in the captains: +1 A, -1 CL.
A furnace of old rage: +1 WS, -1 BS.
Grail of the Red Tide: Feel No Pain (6+).

rites.name: The Descent of the Host
rites.flavor: They fall in a spray of gold, and the sun is behind them.
rites.text: Dawnbreaker Cohorts and the Angel's Tears may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1). Every Antigrav Infantry unit gains +1 Initiative. The Host does not walk: no Heavy sub-type Infantry, no Armour, no Heavy Transports, and at least two Assault Squads (or Veteran Assault Squads) are required.

modifiers.text: The Descent of the Host: Line (1).
The Descent of the Host: +1 I.

require.note: Bring at least two Assault Squads or Veteran Assault Squads.

rites.name: Thirst of the Red Wings
rites.flavor: Sanguinius could hold the rage in his sons. Without him it was a tide.
rites.text: Every non-vehicle model gains +1 Attack on a turn it charges, but loses 1 Cool. The tide cannot be shepherded: no Apothecaries, no Recon units and no Support units other than Techmarines.

modifiers.text: Thirst of the Red Wings: +1 A.
modifiers.condition: on a turn the unit charges

modifiers.text: Thirst of the Red Wings: -1 CL.

rites.name: The Celestial Court
rites.flavor: A Legion of ten thousand, and only the finest ever walk in the Primarch's shadow.
rites.text: Sanguinary Guard, Crimson Paladins and Ofanim Courts may fill Troops slots and gain Line (2). Sanguinary Guard cost 30 points less. The Court takes no commoners: no Tactical Squads, no Despoiler Squads, and no Inductii. At least one Sanguinary Guard and one Crimson Paladin pack are required.

require.note: Bring at least one Sanguinary Guard.
Bring at least one Crimson Paladin pack.

rites.name: Pyre-Brothers of Baal
rites.flavor: The old ones burn, and they remember. They are very, very angry.
rites.text: Contemptor-Incaendius Dreadnoughts may fill Troops slots, gain Line (1) and cost 30 points less. Every Walker gains +1 Attack. The Court of the dead has no room for the living: at least two Contemptor-Incaendius are required, with no Recon units and no Heavy Transports.

require.note: Bring at least two Contemptor-Incaendius Dreadnoughts.
